description: 擅长逃跑的奴隶探索者。生命最低（{max_hp}）、棋盘最窄、背得最少，但带的钱多、走得远、溜得掉。

descriptions.en: A slave explorer who is good at running. Lowest Health ({max_hp}), the narrowest board and the least he can carry, but he brings more money, travels far and slips away.

skills.description: 每走 {travel_discount_every} 步，下一步不计入倒计时。

descriptions.en: Every {travel_discount_every} steps, the next step doesn't count toward the Countdown.

skills.description: 猎手更难发现你，从猎手面前逃跑更容易；首次战败于敌人时不扣体力。

descriptions.en: Hunters have a harder time spotting you and fleeing from them is easier; the first time you lose to an enemy, you lose no Vitality.

skills.description: 开战前脱离：不战斗、不扣体力、无战利品，该点视为已用（核心点不可用）；对猎手使用必定逃脱。

descriptions.en: Slip away before a battle: no fight, no Vitality lost, no loot, and the spot counts as used (not at the core). Always escapes when used on a hunter.

flaw.description: 战斗中，护甲上限降低两成。

descriptions.en: In battle, your maximum Armor is a fifth lower.
